title: Rocket ship
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Exhaust flames -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="85" rx="5" ry="5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="83" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#FFFACD"/>
  <!-- Side exhaust -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="84" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#FF6600"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="84" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#FF6600"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="82" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="82" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#FFD700"/>

  <!-- Rocket body -->
  <path d="M50 10 C50 10, 32 35, 32 65 L68 65 C68 35, 50 10, 50 10 Z" fill="#E8E8E8"/>
  <!-- Body shading / lighter edge -->
  <path d="M50 12 C50 12, 36 36, 36 64 L50 64 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Nose cone -->
  <path d="M50 10 C50 10, 42 24, 40 35 L60 35 C58 24, 50 10, 50 10 Z" fill="#E63946"/>
  <path d="M50 12 C50 12, 45 24, 44 33 L50 33 Z" fill="#FF6B6B"/>

  <!-- Window -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="8" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#2E86DE" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="5" fill="#80D8FF"/>
  <!-- Window shine -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="45" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#E1F5FE" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Porthole rim highlight -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="9.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Left fin -->
  <path d="M32 55 L20 75 L32 70 Z" fill="#E63946"/>
  <path d="M32 58 L23 73 L32 68 Z" fill="#FF6B6B"/>

  <!-- Right fin -->
  <path d="M68 55 L80 75 L68 70 Z" fill="#E63946"/>
  <path d="M68 58 L77 73 L68 68 Z" fill="#FF6B6B"/>

  <!-- Body stripe -->
  <rect x="33" y="60" width="34" height="4" fill="#E63946"/>
  <rect x="33" y="60" width="34" height="1.5" fill="#FF6B6B"/>

  <!-- Bottom nozzle -->
  <path d="M40 65 L38 75 L62 75 L60 65 Z" fill="#A0A0A0"/>
  <path d="M40 67 L39 73 L50 73 L50 67 Z" fill="#C0C0C0"/>
  <rect x="38" y="73" width="24" height="3" rx="1" fill="#888888"/>

  <!-- Stars -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="25" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="35" r="1.8" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="60" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="80" r="1.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="40" r="1.2" fill="#FFF176"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="48" r="1.2" fill="#FFF176"/>

  <!-- Star sparkle shapes -->
  <path d="M20 15 L21 17 L23 18 L21 19 L20 21 L19 19 L17 18 L19 17 Z" fill="#FFF176"/>
  <path d="M80 78 L81 80 L83 81 L81 82 L80 84 L79 82 L77 81 L79 80 Z" fill="#FFF176"/>
</svg>
